Standing atop a morel cap with painted honeycomb-pitted amber ridges rising in deep-walled cells, each pit nearly knee-deep to her, the morel is HER textured tower-top, ridged underfoot.
Perched on a single furled fern-frond spiral still coiled tight, painted lacy spring-green with fine pinnule-serrations along each edge, the frond is HER ladder-tier, its curl taller than she is.
Seated on a vast oak-leaf with painted deep-lobed edges and a raised central vein thick as a road, the leaf is HER raft-map, its amber-green surface stretching to a curved horizon.
Standing on a maple-leaf with painted scarlet-and-gold veining branching outward like river-deltas, the leaf is HER plaza, its winged tip lifting in the breeze like a stage-curtain pulling back.
Curled at the centre of a lily-pad floating on dark water, painted jade-green with pale underside rim showing, the pad is HER island-raft, its waxy surface cool and faintly ridged beneath.
Seated near the raised edge of a lotus-leaf, painted blue-green with a dusty hydrophobic bloom and radiating spoke-veins, the leaf is HER bowl-shaped amphitheatre, its curled rim her armrest.
Curled inside an open foxglove-bell with painted pink-and-purple mottled throat and freckled inner-tunnel curving deep behind, the bell is HER bedroom, its petal-walls soft and arching overhead.
Perched on the curling lip of a tulip-petal, painted pearl-pink with a cream base-blush and faint satin sheen, the petal is HER curved balcony-seat, its edge sweeping away in a long arc.

Curled inside a single overturned poppy-petal, painted scarlet with black-stamped crinkled-silk creases fanning from base to edge, the petal is HER hammock, its translucent walls glowing with filtered light.
Perched in the throat of an iris-petal, painted violet-purple with a yellow bearded-ridge running down the falls like a cobblestone path, the petal is HER curtained chamber, soft walls folding close.

Standing on a moss-covered branch with painted velvety emerald moss-strands rising to her hips, each strand a separate pillar, the branch is HER vast meadow-road, bark ridges rising like earthworks below.
Balanced on a hanging vine-curl looped from a high branch, painted with ridged green bark and fine tendril-hairs spiralling off each side, the vine-curl is HER suspended hammock-swing.

Perched on a fern-tip tendril still unfurling, painted pale soft-green with a tight spiral unwinding slowly, the tendril is HER playground-slide, its coiled spring tall enough to disappear into canopy above.
Seated on a single fallen acorn, painted warm chestnut-brown with a rough-scaled grey cap still attached, the acorn is HER stool, its domed top smooth and wide enough to sit cross-legged.
Seated on a pine-cone, painted with layered brown-and-tan overlapping bracts fanning outward in stacked tiers, the pine-cone is HER tiered throne-chair, each bract-scale a wide armrest at her side.
Balanced on the rim of a giant dewdrop clinging to a leaf-edge, painted with refractive clarity showing the canopy inverted inside its curve, the dewdrop is HER mirror and her cup at once.

Standing inside a rain-collected leaf-bowl where a curled oak-leaf holds a pool, painted with veined walls rising around her, the leaf-bowl is HER private courtyard-cistern, still water reflecting her upward.
Perched on a cluster of dewdrops strung along a spider-silk thread, each drop painted with prismatic refractive shimmer, the drops are HER stepping-stones, each globe knee-high and glassy underfoot.
Riding on the back of a stag-beetle, painted with iridescent blue-green carapace-plates and pronged horns arching far ahead like gateposts, the beetle is HER living mount, its shell wide as a saddle.

Seated on a cluster of ripe winterberries packed tight together, painted glossy scarlet with waxy skin and pale dimpled tips, the cluster is HER cushioned couch, berries packed firm and round beneath.

Curled on a pale lichen-cluster spread across a boulder face, painted with rosette-lobed pale-grey-green frills layered in soft overlapping tiers, the lichen is HER deep cushion, its frilled edges her blanket-folds.
Standing on a red-spotted toadstool cap with painted white-dot crimson surface and pale ribbed gills below, the cap is HER throne, its curve spanning wider than her full arm-spread.
Seated on an amber bracket-mushroom jutting from bark like a shelf, painted warm-honey layered spore-rings and velvet-soft edge, the bracket is HER bench, its width ten times her own.
Perched on a pearl-glow mushroom cap with painted soft cyan inner-light bleeding through translucent flesh, the glowing cap is HER lantern-room, its dome arching high above her.
Balanced on an oyster-mushroom fan with painted pale-grey rippled-gill underside and cream-wave edge, the fan is HER balcony, its curved lip rising to her chin.
Seated inside a morel's deep honeycomb-pit with painted amber-and-ochre ridged-cell walls, the morel is HER tower-room, each pitted alcove large enough to cradle her curled inside.
Perched on a single furled fern-frond with painted lacy bright-green spiral-coil detail, the frond is HER ladder, its unfurling tip taller than three of her stacked.
Standing on a giant oak-leaf with painted deep-carved veining and curled serrated edge, the leaf is HER floor, its central rib running like a ridge-road beneath her feet.
Balanced on a maple-leaf with painted scarlet-and-gold flame veining and notched lobes, the leaf is HER raft, each lobe a bay wider than her full height.
Seated on a floating lily-pad with painted jade-green surface and pale-stitched veining, the pad is HER island, its waxy upturned rim rising to her waist like a wall.
Curled on a lotus-leaf with painted silver-beaded water-drops resting on blue-green waxy surface, the leaf is HER vast cloak spread beneath her, its rolled edge her pillow.
Curled inside an open foxglove-bell with painted pink-and-purple mottled-throat and spotted inner-freckles, the bell is HER bedroom, its curved petal-walls arching overhead like a cathedral.
Perched on the curling edge of a tulip-petal with painted pearl-pink waxy-smooth surface, the petal is HER balcony-seat, its upward curve rising three times her height on each side.
Seated inside a single overturned poppy-petal with painted scarlet crinkled-silk texture and black-smudge base, the petal is HER hammock, its deep fold cradling her like a cupped hand.
Standing on a moss-covered branch with painted velvety green-moss strands rising hip-high around her, the branch is HER road, its bark-ridges running beneath the moss like buried cobblestones.
Balanced on a hanging twig with painted silver-lichen crust and rough grey bark-surface, the twig is HER tightrope, its girth as wide as her waist, swaying gently.
Perched on a curling vine-tendril with painted deep-green ribbed surface and coiling spiral tip, the tendril is HER hammock-swing, its loop large enough to seat her inside its curl.
Standing on a fern-tip still unfurling with painted pale-green soft-spiral and silvered fine-hair fringe, the fern-tip is HER playground-slide, its slow uncoil shifting her weight gently forward.
Seated on a giant fallen acorn with painted brown-and-tan cap-scale texture and smooth pale-tan body, the acorn is HER stool, its cap-rim at shoulder-height when she stands beside it.
Perched on a pine-cone with painted brown-and-russet layered overlapping scales, the pine-cone is HER throne-chair, its open scale-tiers forming natural steps up to where she rests.

Balanced on the rim of a single giant dewdrop with painted refractive-crystal clarity and canopy-light caught inside, the dewdrop is HER mirror-cup, its curved surface reflecting her entire world upward.
Seated beside a leaf-bowl-of-rain with painted translucent green walls and rain-pooled silver water inside, the leaf-bowl is HER bathing-pool, its rim curving above her at full standing height.
Riding on the back of a stag-beetle with painted iridescent blue-green carapace and ridged horn-detail, the beetle is HER mount, its shell-width spanning the breadth of her outstretched arms.
Perched on the back of a great morpho-butterfly with painted electric-blue scaled wing-surface and dark eye-spot, the wing is HER sail-deck, each scale beneath her the size of her palm.

Perched on a cluster of glowing-lichen with painted pale-grey-green phosphor texture and soft amber pulse, the lichen-cluster is HER cushioned throne, its sponge-soft lobes yielding gently beneath her weight.
Balanced on a single spider-silk strand hung with painted refractive dewdrop-beads, the thread is HER tightrope-bridge, each dewdrop bead beside her as wide and tall as her own head.
